secure_mail_loaded:
    type: event
    description: >
      Triggers when different kinds of secure emails are loaded.
    bugs:
      - https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1615994
      - https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1899602
      - https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1867271
    data_reviews:
      - https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1615994#c22
    data_sensitivity:
      - technical
    notification_emails:
      - telemetry-client-dev@thunderbird.net
    expires: never
    extra_keys:
      security:
        description: Security technology. "OpenPGP" or "S/MIME".
        type: string
      is_signed:
        description: Whether the email was digitally signed.
        type: boolean
      is_encrypted:
        description: Whether the email was encrypted.
        type: boolean
